Thailand - Exercise a high degree of caution

Exercise a high degree of caution in Thailand due to ongoing political tensions and sporadic demonstrations in Bangkok and elsewhere in the country.

Thailand-Cambodia border - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to the area within 50 kilometres of the Thailand-Cambodia border due to ongoing tensions in the region.

 

Southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala and southern Songkhla province - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to the following southern provinces and region due to violent attacks from separatist insurgents and the unpredictable security situation:

  • Narathiwat
  • Pattani
  • Yala
  • southern Songkhla province:
    • Hat Yai city
    • east of Highways 408 and 4113, including Sakom
